data_role: already viewed development; saved continuation replay only
pixel_identity: Per raw node pair: flattened target pixel ID and flattened sampled source pixel ID
classification: Exact retained pair; same source retargeted; disappeared source; appeared source
geometric_counts: All candidate pair occurrences before factor admission; not unique observations
cost: Sum Huber(r,0.01m) of admitted factors plus unchanged nonlinear incoming marginal prior
decomposition: F_old(after)-F_old(before); F_new(after)-F_old(after); sum gives population-dependent total change
gate_accounting: An edge crossing200 adds or removes its entire cost; distinguish this from geometric pixel turnover
controls: Identity and shifted rendered pixels at scales4/2/1
